description: This file provides functions for generating textual reports based on topology data related to module exports, ownership, and consumers within a project. It defines multiple report modules such as 'public-surface-usage', 'owner-map', 'single-owner-shared', 'unused-public-surface', and 'consumer-topology', each with descriptive output functions. The file also imports specific types and exports a function to render the appropriate report.
